4710-3 Postmarketing requirement, PREA (FDCA 505B), due Jun 30, 2030. Conduct a pharmacokinetic, safety and efficacy study of LMN-201 in pediatric patients 2 to less than 18 years of age for the prevention of recurrent C. difficile infection. Record
